config.label: Bearer key
config.description: Bearer key. Get one at https://chieflab.io/get-key. Or run `npx @chieflab/cli login` after install for a saved-config alternative.

config.label: Bearer clp_live_<your-key> or clp_dev_<your-key>
config.description: Bearer clp_live_<your-key> or clp_dev_<your-key>. Get one at https://chieflab.io/get-key (one click, no email) or programmatically via the chieflab_signup_workspace tool. Raw key (no `Bearer ` prefix) is also accepted for gateway compatibility.
